# tritonctl api-key

Manage your API keys, for scripts and CI

Subcommands: create, list, delete

Usage: `tritonctl api-key [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl api-key create

Mint a new API key. The secret is shown once

Usage: `tritonctl api-key create [OPTIONS]`

- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`: Free-text label, e.g. `ci-pipeline`. Defaults to `Created by tritonctl <version> on <UTC timestamp>`
- `--scope <SCOPE>`: What the key may do: `full` acts as you; `read-only` can list and show only (one of: booter, full, read-only, tenant-write, audit-only, agent, ur-enroll, dnsedge, certs; default: full)

## tritonctl api-key list

List your API keys. No secret material

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl api-key list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl api-key delete

Delete one of your API keys

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl api-key delete [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Key description, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
